rules: Every hour of every recording, for each body: the planner's command with the smallest, the middle and the largest hands distance at its end (the average of the two hands' finger distances from their asked-for angles, degrees), and with the smallest and the largest whole-body distance (the average angle of the powered body parts among the 15 scored ones from their asked-for directions); and one command drawn at random.
At each run's start: the first planner command 100, 1,000 and 10,000 model steps after it (a repair or any other change starts a new run).

Within each run, for each body: an hour whose middle hands distance is lower (or higher) than every earlier hour of the same run (runs with other settings, and sibling runs restarted from one checkpoint, are never joined).
In each test run, for each body: its middle and its largest hands distance over the whole run.
